1479-2841-3897-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4186-4279-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-5789.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

678-4022-5147.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-5147.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

5078-6650-6791-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-6791-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3967-4772-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3967-4772-5254.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

147-1893-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-6798.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2595-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-6723-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

2111-5330-6982.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1169-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-1251-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-1251-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-5075-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-5075-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1563-2351-6460-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-7297.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3693-5220-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Walking Ballista from your library.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2511-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

997-2932-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
997-2932-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
997-2932-5220-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

129-4824-6006.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-4824-6006.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2232-4890-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-4890-6749.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Dack's Duplicate enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Dack's Duplicate from the battlefield to your hand.
When Dack's Duplicate leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Dack's Duplicate from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

3670-4508-5396.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3670-4508-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, giving Ingenious Artillerist the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Trickery Charm, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

3088-3525-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3088-3525-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3088-3525-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

565-1858-6231--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-6231--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

913-2034-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

222-527-2079-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

341-586-2438-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1636-3654-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-3654-4186.description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1202-2055-4050-4985.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {W}.
Myr Moonvessel dies, adding {C}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {0}.
Repeat.

401-4050-5004.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
401-4050-5004.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {1}.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and Decaying Soil.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Cathodion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat.

4694-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
Aetherflux Reservoir does not have summoning sickness.
4694-4740.description:
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink, if needed.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 2.
